# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
If the records do not sufficiently document each emission event, use "witness statements" from the operators who have witnessed the event to supplement the monitoring records.
    1. If the monitoring records are missing, use any eyewitness accounts to determine an approximation for the missing data.
3. For each monitoring system, and for each day, determine if any emissions outside of the permitted standard emissions occurred. 
4. For each day, determine which of the emissions' thresholds were exceeded.
    1. Make a list of the dates where gas emissions were outside the permitted standard.
5. Create a table to report the data.
6. Create the "text" report for each day, copying/pasting into the text report the content of the monitoring data for that day.
